Package com.stzteam.features.advantagekitbridge.annotations

Annotation Interface LogName

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(FIELD) public @interface LogName
Overrides the AdvantageKit log key used for a field of a MARS Data class.

By default the bridge derives the key from the field name (see BridgeConfig.KeyStyle). Use this annotation when a field name and its desired log key must differ, for example to keep an existing AdvantageScope layout working after a refactor. 

 public class ArmInputs extends Data<ArmInputs> {
     @LogName("PositionDeg")
     public double position = 0.0;
 }

The key must be stable across toLog and fromLog, which it is, since both are derived from the same annotation. Changing it invalidates replay of older logs.
